verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents approval flows for invoice payments (jeeves-docs-27) and lets admins customize roles and employee permissions (jeeves-docs-22, jeeves-docs-29, jeeves-docs-37), which covers the core of permissioned payment approvals. Nothing documents how approvers are designated or that approving and sending is a single one-click action. Missing for 10: explicit approver-designation/approval-rule configuration docs, evidence of one-click approve-and-send, independent or hands-on corroboration.
